name: Kirarazaka Kaede
source:
The loli 3rd year. She’s Kazehime (Wind princess). Her family is in charge of the Kirara Group which is, simply said, one of the biggest groups on earth. Childish, bright and sociable. She likes games, anime and the like. There are problems that happen sometimes because of her personality, but it’s always solved as she is hardworking.
